stem: The third paragraph (sentences 14-18) starts abruptly. Which sentence could be added before sentence 14 to best introduce the ideas presented in this paragraph?

options.label: A
options.text: The “human calculator” is a person who thinks like a calculator.

options.label: B
options.text: Helping people is important to the “human calculator.”

options.label: D
options.text: Flansburg solves problems that are complicated.
